pages.text: A focus born from the Void, crafted to mimic the Enderman's teleportation ability.$(br)Aim your crosshair at a target and cast to lock on.$(br)Within 10 seconds of locking on, press shift to teleport behind the target. After teleporting, you have another 10 seconds to shift-teleport again — up to five consecutive teleports by default.$(br)$(4)"Once you've locked onto your prey, never let go — but remember, the roles of hunter and hunted can reverse at any moment."$()
